role: Independent read-only source review by attention worker; no converter checkout edits or extra builds
conclusions: GPT-2 swaps the first two tensor axes while copying intact trailing blocks. NeoX treats original [head,QKV,head_width,row_width] storage as a head/QKV block transpose; the resulting Q/K/V major order matches frozen conversion/gptneox.py. Bias reshape additionally requires hidden divisibility, while the original weight reshape can admit zero-row/nondivisible edge shapes with an exact element count.

Only source Conv1D suffixes and the original NeoX raw prefix trigger transforms. Canonical mapped aliases remain unchanged. NeoX checks explicit null head/embedding aliases before tensor-name dispatch, preserving the original unconditional assertions.

Family metadata override order is preserved: GPT-2 requires n_ctx, uses 4*n_embd regardless of n_inner and emits file_type. NeoX truncates rotary_pct times floor-divided head width and intentionally omits generic file_type/RoPE-base/scaling fields. Qwen-only sidecar paths are guarded away from GPT families.

Scalar preparation precedes byte permutation and shared output encoding. Checked products establish every block-copy index; transformed buffers are charged to the existing conservative cumulative budget before allocation. Empty prepared buffers exit before leading-dimension loops.

GPTNeoX class defaults and disabled default BOS/EOS feed existing checked fast-tokenizer behavior. Mandatory model.type remains enforced for non-GPT converter paths; the legacy absent tag exception is confined to the source GPT vocabulary families. Explicit null or unsupported type is not reinterpreted as BPE.

Complete-file tests verify packed input blob digests, output length and SHA-256, plus fixed accepted/rejected/byte counts. The class test verifies exact encoding/decoding records and cursor-independent aggregate counts. No new expected numerical data is computed by product code.

The ignored GPT-2 helper verifies the complete official input set before and after, recognizes exactly twelve pinned static mask names/shapes, retains 148 tensor ranges unchanged, recreates the derivative through Rust I/O, and verifies its independently captured whole-file hash. It does not alter product converter behavior: unmodified official source rejection is still tested, and accepted conversions require complete output hashes.
qualifications: This is source, test-helper and contract review; worker owns final debug/release, strict lint and pretrained execution reports. No independent test rerun or build was performed for this review.
Generated alias tables were inspected as declarative data and pinned by full-file hash; this review is not a second exhaustive regeneration of all 553 source mapping rows.

Source rejections are compared as admission failures; tests do not require identical Python exception messages. Tokenizer non-deterministic native error word order is explicitly excluded by the corpus contract.

The pretrained helper is specific to hash-pinned original inputs and a fresh external output directory. Model weights remain external, and conversion support does not close inference, full converter, ABI or release gates.
